admission.justification: The package range, uv-managed environment producers, minor-link checker without invoking uv, and stale-checkout migration inventory together ensure every product environment runs on one upgradeable Python 3.14 minor line; no single member provides that whole boundary.

guarantee: The product runs on uv-managed Python 3.14 as one stated runtime: package metadata admits >=3.14,<3.15, every product environment uses uv-managed CPython 3.14 and the uv 0.13 minor line with no source build or patch pin, the hook and checker verify the minor and unresolved uv minor symlink without running uv, and bootstrap plus runtime_install migrate and report stale registered checkouts.
title: One Python runtime stated and enforced
